correctness.rationale: Reconstructed strict Nash deviation comparisons. Adding inequalities for two same-village clients assigned to different sites yields C/k+C/l<=C/(k+1)+C/(l+1), impossible. The only equilibrium profiles are the two poolings (r<=1-1/(2m)) and home segregation (r>=1/[m(m+1)]); crossing fails strict comparison. Welfare OPT=min(C+md,2C), giving exact attained worst-PNE envelope 4/3 (m=1), 3/2 (m=2), (2m+1)/4 (m>=3). Independently enumerated 33 rational (m,d,C) regimes with all labeled profiles for m<=5; these checks support but do not prove arbitrary m.
